justifications.en: This milestone was erected on the route from Jerusalem to Damascus where this important monument was built by the Umayyads on the pilgrimage route.

justifications.en: The milestone was erected on the route from Damascus to Jerusalem where the pilgrims visited this monument built on the site of Prophet Muhammad’s Ascension.
justifications.fr: La borne fut érigée sur la route de Damas à Jérusalem où les pèlerins visitaient ce monument construit sur le site de l’Ascension du prophète Muhammad.
